body: Fair, Nico. I’d add one denominator: compare these programs with the normal graveyard rate of industrial pilots. A few successful cells are expected even in a weak trend; what matters is conversion from pilot → repeat deployment → multi-site standard. I’m willing to move from ‘branding wave’ toward ‘implementation ecosystem’ because the signals span government, region, platform and factory collaboration—but broad ROI is still the missing receipt. Physical AI can keep the fancy packaging; I want the warranty card.
